categories.title: General Store
categories.info: General Stores sell any non-clothing item, usually within a specific theme of crafting materials. Unlike Boutiques, their map icons aren't marked with a tick even after you buy everything.

categories.title: Warp Spire
categories.info: Activate Warp Spires to unlock fast travel and respawn points across Miraland. You can fast travel by selecting a spire from the map screen. Each one discovered gives 20x Diamonds.

categories.title: Curio Domain
categories.info: Enter Curio gateways to complete skill challenges and earn Whimstars.

categories.title: Mini Game
categories.info: Test your skills with obstacle courses throughout Miraland! Each mini-game attempt costs 100 Blings. Your first Clear awards 10 Diamonds, and your first Perfect Clear awards 30 more Diamonds.

categories.title: Styling Challenge
categories.info: Styling Challenges are essentially the "boss battles" of fashion in Miraland. Rise through the faction ranks until Nikki reaches can challenge the regional Sovereign.

categories.title: Danqing Jade Soul
categories.info: Danqing Jade Souls can be collected with Purification moves, and are traded to [Zhou Suchan](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/danqing-island?locationIds=473626) for Resonance, Crafting and Dyeing resources.

categories.title: Lore Item
categories.info: Books and other documents that expand on the lore of Infinity Nikki. These are logged in the Pearpal's Lore section of the Compendium.

categories.title: Whim Jade
categories.info: Whim Jades can be traded with [Zhou Suchan](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/danqing-island?locationIds=473626) for Resonance, Crafting and Dyeing resources.

categories.title: Chest (Advanced)
categories.info:
Advanced Chests are sparkling pink-and-white boxes found throughout Miraland. In addition to normal chest rewards, they sometimes contain rare items like Outfit Sketches and Fragrances.

**Rewards:**
- Diamond x 30
- Bling x 1,000
- Mira EXP x 40
- Thread of Purity x 20

categories.title: Chest (Intermediate)
categories.info:
**Rewards:**

- Diamond x10
- Thread of Purity x10
- Blings x500

categories.title: Chest (Primary)
categories.info:
**Rewards:**

- Mira EXP x 10

categories.title: Exclusive Quest
categories.info: Exclusive Quests are the longest kind of side quests, often involving a lengthy quest chain. Story quests tied to new updates will use Exclusive Quests in lieu of Main Quests.

categories.title: Random Quest
categories.info: Random Quests are short side quests that can usually be completed in the area where you started them.

categories.title: World Quest
categories.info: World Quests are side quests that, as the name implies, tend to send Nikki all across the map the quest is given in.

categories.title: Inkrealm Scroll
categories.info: Inkrealm Scrolls become active once you complete [Trace the Path to Reveal the Fate](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/danqing-island?locationIds=474945), then restore them with Danqing. Used to travel between the Danqing Island and Realm, they also act as fast travel points.
